name: Amitriptyline
short: A tricyclic blocking NET and SERT plus H1, α1, muscarinic receptors and sodium channels.
mechanism: Like most TCAs it blocks both **NET** and **SERT** to some extent, plus the four unwanted TCA actions: **H1, muscarinic, α1** and **voltage-sensitive sodium channel** blockade.

targets.note: Most TCAs block both to some extent
Weak at therapeutic doses; lethal in overdose

facts.text: Entered clinical practice **before molecular clarification of the serotonin transporter site**.

nbn: Norepinephrine (and serotonin) reuptake inhibitor with multiple receptor antagonism
uses: Unipolar depression (second line, for treatment resistance)

sideEffects.e: Sedation, weight gain
Dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary retention, constipation
Orthostatic hypotension, dizziness
Overdose: coma, seizures, arrhythmia, cardiac arrest (lethal dose ≈ 30-day supply)
